question: When and where is the wedding?
answer: Saturday, July 17, 2027, at the Chicago Athletic Association Hotel, 12 S Michigan Ave, Chicago, IL 60603.

question: What time does it start?
answer: Please arrive 15–30 minutes before the ceremony. Ceremony and reception times will appear on The Wedding page once our planner confirms them.

question: What should I wear?
answer: We would love to see you dressed up for an evening in a historic ballroom—cocktail attire or anything more formal. Black tie is welcome. Men: a suit with a dress shirt, preferably with a tie (a tuxedo is welcome too). Women: a cocktail dress, an elegant jumpsuit, dressy separates, or a formal gown. Please skip jeans, chinos, and khakis.

question: Can we bring our kids?
answer: Please refer to your invitation for the guests included in your party. If you have questions about your invitation, please reach out to us.

question: Can I bring a plus-one?
answer: Please refer to your invitation for the guests included in your party. If you have questions about your invitation, please reach out to us.

question: Where do I park?
answer: The hotel's valet entrance, parking options, and current rates are kept as dated records on Our Venue, each with the day we last checked them against the hotel's own page.

question: How do I get to the wedding venue?
answer: Our wedding takes place at the Chicago Athletic Association Hotel, 12 S Michigan Ave, Chicago, IL 60603. See Travel & Stay for directions, parking, and getting around downtown.

question: What if it rains?
answer: Our ceremony and reception will take place indoors at the Chicago Athletic Association. Check the weather before traveling, especially if you’ll be exploring the city.

question: Can I take photos?
answer: We invite you to be fully present during our unplugged ceremony by putting away your phones and cameras. Share this special moment with us while our photographer captures the memories.

question: Is the venue accessible?
answer: The hotel describes its accessible rooms and features on its own FAQ page; the link and the date we last checked it are on Our Venue. TODO(Tyler & Sara): accessibility details for the ceremony and reception rooms once they are chosen (backlog P-01).

question: How do I RSVP?
answer: Sign in with a one-time code sent to the email on your invitation to see your guest details and RSVP when it opens. You can return to your guest account to review your reply and change meal selections once the menu is available and meal changes are open.

question: Where should I stay, and how do I get there?
answer: Travel & Stay covers getting to Chicago and getting around downtown. Sign in to see your room-block booking code, rate, and book-by date at the Chicago Athletic Association.

question: Do you have a registry?
answer: Your presence at our wedding is the greatest gift. Sign in to see our Gifts page for the details.

question: How do I reach you?
answer: Email us at hello@kendrick.wedding. We read every message and share questions with our wedding planner, Michelle Elaine Sunder of Bustle & Lace.

question: What if I have dietary restrictions or food allergies?
answer: Sign in to review your RSVP and the dietary information you can share with us. Meal choices will appear once the menu is available; we’ll share any additional catering guidance as it is confirmed.
